user.title: Add an RNET Bridge
user.description: Enter the address of the bridge. It is usually found automatically on your network.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address, for example rnet-bridge-1a2b.local.
data_description.port: Leave at 80 unless you changed it.
data_description.token: Only if you set an API token in the bridge's setup portal.
Only if you set an API token in the bridge's setup portal.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Choose which controller zones to add, and name them. You can change this later.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Choose which sources to offer, and name them. Disabled sources are hidden from source lists.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the API token
reauth_confirm.description: The RNET Bridge at {host} rejected the API token. Enter the token set in the bridge's setup portal, or leave it empty if the token was removed.

data_description.token: Set in the bridge's setup portal (double-press the reset button to open it).

abort.unsupported_proto: The bridge firmware speaks a different API version. Update the bridge firmware or this integration.
abort.wrong_bridge: That address answers as a different RNET Bridge than the one being updated.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to the RNET Bridge at {host}.

not_connected.message: Could not send {command}: the RNET Bridge is not connected.

command_link_down.message: Could not send {command}: the RNET link to the controller is down.

command_failed.message: The RNET Bridge could not run {command}.

unknown_source.message: {source} is not an enabled source. Enable it in the integration options.

entry_not_found.message: No RNET Bridge with config entry ID {entry_id}.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Choose which controller zones appear in Home Assistant, and name them. Disabled zones' devices are removed.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Choose which sources to offer, and name them. Disabled sources are hidden from source lists.

unsupported_proto.title: RNET Bridge firmware and integration don't match
unsupported_proto.description: {title} speaks API version {proto}, but this integration supports version {supported}. Update the bridge firmware and the integration to the same release: each GitHub release ships both, with matching versions.

send_raw.name: Send raw RNET frame
send_raw.description: Debug tool: sends raw bytes to the controller through the bridge. Use with care.

config_entry_id.name: Bridge
config_entry_id.description: The RNET Bridge to send through.

hex.name: Hex bytes
hex.description: Bytes as hex, for example F0 00 00 7F ... F7.

fix_checksum.name: Append checksum
fix_checksum.description: The hex runs from F0 to the last body byte; the bridge appends the checksum and F7.
